map.由核数与活度反推半衰期 使用指南: Half-Life from Number of Nuclei and Activity User Guide
map.由核数与活度反推半衰期工具依据 t½=N·ln2/A 由核素总数与活度求半衰期，: The half-life from number of nuclei and activity tool uses t1/2 = N*ln2/A to get the half-life from the total number of nuclides and the activity, for back-calculating radioactive sample characteristics and nuclear physics exercises.
map.输入核数 N 与活度 A，求半衰期。: Enter the number of nuclei N and the activity A to find the half-life.
map.th = N·ln2/A 由核数与活度反推半衰期。: th = N*ln2/A back-calculates the half-life from the number of nuclei and the activity.
map.：th = 1e20 × 0.693147 / 3.833e8 ≈ 1.808×: : th = 1e20 x 0.693147 / 3.833e8, about 1.808 x 10^11 s, about 5730 years (that is, C-14).
map.：若 A=7.666e8，则 th 减半为 9.04e10 s，衰变更快。: : If A = 7.666e8, th halves to 9.04e10 s and decay is faster.
map.公式来源？: Where does the formula come from?
map.由 A=λN 与 λ=ln2/th 消元得 th=N·ln2/A。: Eliminating A = lambda*N and lambda = ln2/th gives th = N*ln2/A.
map.测定时假设核数仅因衰变减少、无增减来源，否则需校正。: The measurement assumes the number of nuclei decreases only through decay with no other source or loss; otherwise a correction is needed.
